history.headline: Second day off the trail, still no run logged. Absorption is taking longer than a single day — which is exactly right after three back-to-back ultra days. Watch for the first easy run to tell the real recovery story.
watch_items: Watch whether the first easy run back sits at normal HR for its pace, or runs elevated — the clearest read on whether the crossing is still being paid down.
Watch for strength to re-enter the log; its continued absence is now the most open thread from the block.
Watch whether the calendar returns to its usual interleaved rhythm rather than extending the current gap.
Watch whether sleep consolidates now that the block's short broken nights are behind you.

history.headline: The trail block ran longer than the last read suggested — multiple back-to-back ultra-distance days at controlled HR are now logged. The engine held its shape throughout. Absorption is the next real question.
watch_items: Watch whether strength genuinely re-enters the log now that the concentrated foot volume is easing, rather than staying crowded out.
Watch whether easy-run HR settles back to normal for its pace as the big days taper, confirming the block is being absorbed cleanly.
Watch whether sleep consolidates now that the block's short, broken nights should be behind you.
Watch whether the calendar returns to its interleaved rhythm rather than extending continuous running volume.

history.headline: Three days off the trail with no run logged yet. Absorption is genuine, not delayed — steps stay high, but structured work is fully paused. The first easy run remains the real test.
watch_items: Watch whether the first logged run comes back at a normal easy-pace HR, confirming the block absorbed cleanly rather than lingering as fatigue.
Watch whether strength finally re-enters the log — the layoff is now long enough that its continued absence would be a pattern, not just a gap.
Watch whether the return to training reinstates the interleaved run/strength rhythm rather than restarting continuous running volume.
Watch whether the high all-day step count settles as formal training resumes, or whether it stays elevated as a persistent background load.

history.headline: Still no run logged since the trail block — absorption has now run several days deeper than a single easy-day reset. Steps stay high; structured work stays fully paused. The first run remains the untaken test.
watch_items: Watch whether the first logged run returns at a normal easy HR, which would confirm the block absorbed cleanly rather than lingering as fatigue.
Watch whether the resumption reintroduces any real intensity, or whether running restarts entirely easy and leaves the top end untested for even longer.
Watch whether strength re-enters the log at all — its continued absence is now a standing feature, not a post-block gap.
Watch whether the persistently high step count settles once structured training resumes, or holds as a permanent background load worth accounting for.

history.headline: Still no run since the trail block — absorption has now run longer than any easy reset would need. Steps hold high as a permanent background load. The first structured session remains untaken.
watch_items: Watch whether the first logged run finally appears, and whether it returns at a normal easy HR — that remains the single outstanding test of whether the block absorbed cleanly.
Watch whether the gap since the last run tips from earned absorption into an unplanned layoff — the length now matters more than the reason.
Watch whether strength re-enters at all when running resumes, or whether both remain paused together.
Watch whether the persistently high background step load is quietly substituting for structured easy volume during this pause.
